title: Portuguese Chocolate Pudding
description: A rich and creamy Portuguese-inspired dessert featuring chocolate pudding, perfect for warm weather.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, chocolate, and pudding mix. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the sugar until dissolved.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and melted butter.
Gradually add the egg mixture to the saucepan with the pudding mixture, whisking constantly.
Return the saucepan to the stovetop and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let cool to room temperature.
Cover the pudding and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Serve chilled, garnished with chocolate shavings or whipped cream if desired.
